scope: Independent full-text, source-bound review of statements, method, category relevance, quotations and conversion limits. This receipt grants no human verification, screening-state change, domain-expert verification or publication authority.

findings.finding: The quotation resolves exactly. The baseline mixed-method design, 152 survey respondents, two focus groups with seven participants, 255 free-text responses, five tensions and five curriculum propositions agree with the source.

The category list overstates Fairness and excludes Bias_Ungleichheit. The paper addresses discriminatory narratives, algorithmic bias, unequal accessibility and equity, which support Bias_Ungleichheit. It does not study algorithmic-fairness metrics or evaluate a fair-ML/debiasing method, so Fairness is not established under assessment/categories.yaml. Replace Fairness with Bias_Ungleichheit or qualify the category claim.

The baseline-before-sustained-use boundary, single Scottish local authority and nonrepresentativeness are accurate. Linearised source tables were available and figures were not independently inspected; the reviewed sample and curriculum claims are stated in prose and do not require figure interpretation.
